_comment: Rule-based chatbot flows for HomeHaat. Edit text, keywords, quick replies and links here. {placeholders} are filled from store settings. Actions: list_categories | search_products | show_offers | track_order (built into js/components/chatbot.js).

bot.name: Haat Helper
bot.subtitle: Usually replies instantly · not an AI

greeting.text:
Namaste! 👋 I'm {botName}, the {storeName} assistant.
I can help you find products, offers, delivery info, track an order and more. What would you like to do?

intents.label: 🛍️ Browse categories
intents.text: Here are our categories — tap one to start browsing:

intents.label: 🔎 Find a product
intents.text: Sure! Type the product you're looking for — for example “kadai”, “bedsheet”, “steam iron” or “towel”.

intents.label: 🎟️ How to apply a coupon
intents.text:
To apply a coupon:
1️⃣ Add products to your cart
2️⃣ Open the Cart (or Checkout)
3️⃣ Type the code in “Have a coupon?” and tap Apply
The discount shows instantly in the price breakdown. Codes to try: {couponCodes}.

intents.label: 🚚 Delivery charges & time
💳 COD vs online payment
intents.text:
You can pay two ways:
💵 Cash on Delivery — available on orders up to ₹{codLimit}. Pay by cash or UPI to the delivery partner.
💳 Online — UPI or debit/credit card on our secure payment page. Prepaid orders are dispatched first.
If an online payment fails, no money is deducted and you can retry or switch to COD.

intents.label: 📦 Track my order
intents.text: Please type your order ID — it looks like HH100012 (you'll find it in your confirmation email or My Account → Orders).

intents.label: ↩️ Returns & refunds
intents.text:
↩️ Eligible products can be returned within the window shown on each product page (usually 7–10 days after delivery). Products under ₹1,000 and some items are not returnable.
🚚 Return pickup is free.
▶️ Start a return from My Account → Orders once the order is delivered.
💰 Online payments are refunded to the original payment method in 5–7 working days. For Cash on Delivery we send the refund to your UPI ID.
❌ You can cancel an order yourself from My Account → Orders until it is confirmed.

intents.label: 👤 Account, login & addresses
intents.text:
👤 Create an account or log in to save addresses and track orders.
🔑 Forgot your password? Use “Forgot password” on the login page — we'll email a reset link.
📍 Manage addresses (with a map pin for accurate delivery) under My Account → Addresses.

intents.label: 🙋 Talk to a human
🙏 Thanks
intents.text: You're welcome! 😊 Anything else I can help with?

intents.label: 👋 Hello
intents.text: Hello! 👋 How can I help you today?

fallback.text: Sorry, I didn't quite get that 🤔 Here's what I can help with:

messages.searchNone: I couldn't find products for “{q}”. Try another word, or browse categories.
messages.trackNotFound: I couldn't find order “{q}”. Please check the ID (e.g. HH100012) and try again.
messages.offersNone: No special deals right now — check back soon!
